setup_body: Add VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY to your .env file, then restart the dev server.
dash_empty_body: Create a request, then send the link by email or WhatsApp.
form_phone_hint: Include the country code, for example 971501234567.
form_due_hint: Suggested from the template. Check it against the official deadline.
form_email_cap: The request was created, but today's email limit is reached. Send the link by WhatsApp.
form_email_failed: The request was created, but the email could not be sent. Copy the link instead.
detail_rotate_confirm: Replace the link? The old link will stop working.
detail_archive_confirm: Archive this request? Reminders will stop.
settings_notify_hint: We email you when a client has uploaded everything.
settings_reply_hint: Clients who reply to reminders reach this address.
error_cap: Today's email limit is reached. Send the link by WhatsApp or try again tomorrow.
error_plan: Your trial limit is reached. Contact us to continue.
client_intro: {firm} needs these documents from you. Add them in any order. Your phone camera works too.
client_done_body: {firm} has all the required documents. You can still add more below.
client_secure: Files travel over a secure connection and are shared only with {firm}.
client_not_found_body: Ask your accountant for a new link.
client_err_large: That file is over 25 MB. Try a smaller photo or a PDF.
client_err_type: Use a PDF, photo, Word or Excel file.
client_err_generic: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
billing_usage: {used} of {limit} requests used on the free trial
billing_past_due: Your last payment failed. Update your card in Manage billing to avoid an interruption.
billing_canceled: Your subscription has ended. Upgrade to create new requests and send reminders.
billing_done: Thanks! Your plan updates as soon as the payment is confirmed.
billing_unavailable: Billing isn't available right now. Please try again later.
